verdict.rationale: MotherDuck ships natural-language interfaces (Dives, MCP server) letting business users ask questions conversationally and get SQL/charts back, and explicitly supports 'Guides' - markdown docs capturing org metric definitions and join conventions so agents produce accurate SQL without hallucinated joins - plus governance controls (read-only restriction, role-based sharing) to keep answers scoped and safe. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence that Guides actually reduce hallucinated joins in practice, and no third-party benchmark of answer accuracy vs. hallucination.
